progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bk3 and dwells most on C in Farang, Shushtari-Gardan. The line peaks at Fs4 (345.8 Hz) at 0:11.0. It closes on C4, not the tonic (Fk4 → Fk4 → Fk4 → Fk4 → C4 → C4).
